summary: UMH Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement for its existing unsecured revolving credit facility. The amendment, with BMO, JPMorgan, and Wells Fargo as joint lead arrangers, increases available borrowings to $260M with a $340M accordion feature, extends maturity from November 7, 2026 to May 7, 2030 (with a one-year extension option), and reduces interest rate spreads by 35–40 bps to SOFR+1.30%–1.90% or prime+0.30%–0.90%. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
